About.title: Veteran-owned, and personal about it
About.subtitle: Limpios started from one idea: bring the attention to detail I learned in the service, plus real local care, to every business and property we clean.

story.title: Our story
body: Hi, I'm Papo. I started Limpios after I got out of the military and moved my family to the Clermont area. I'd been cleaning offices and houses on the side, and the people who hired me kept telling me the same thing: the crews they'd used before would cut corners, show up late, or just stop answering the phone.

That bugged me. In the service you show up on time, you do the job all the way, and you own it when something's off. So I built Limpios to run like that. Same crew, a written checklist we actually follow, and a phone that gets answered.
These days we work with businesses, property managers, builders and homeowners across Central Florida — and I'm usually out on jobs myself. I like it that way.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Take cleaning off your plate with work that's reliable, accountable, and done right the first time. When you bring in Limpios, you're handing your space to people who actually care how the job turns out.

eco.title: Our eco-friendly commitment
eco.body: We use eco-friendly, low-odor products that are hard on dirt and easy on the people who use the space every day. A healthier clean shouldn't cost you the air in your own building.

pricing.a: It depends on the space — square footage, scope, condition, and the crew the job needs. That's why we don't publish flat rates: we walk your space free of charge, then send a written estimate, usually within a day. No obligation and no surprises.

walkthrough.a: We visit your space at a time that works for you, walk the scope together, and note the square footage, condition and access. It takes 15–30 minutes for most spaces, it's completely free, and you'll have a written estimate shortly after — usually the same day.

area.a: We're based in Lake County and work throughout Central Florida — Clermont, Minneola, Winter Garden and well beyond. If your property is in the region, call us or request an estimate and we'll confirm right away.

insured.a: Yes. Limpios holds a business license and carries insurance, and everyone on the team is vetted and background-checked before they ever set foot on your site. (Florida doesn't require a specialty trade license for cleaning services — our license is the standard business license to operate.)

eco.q: Are your products safe for offices, kids and pets?
eco.a: Yes. We use eco-friendly, low-odor products that are tough on dirt but gentle on the people — and pets — who use the space. If anyone on site has allergies or sensitivities, tell us and we'll adjust.

supplies.q: Do I need to provide supplies or equipment?
supplies.a: No. We bring our own professional equipment and eco-friendly supplies. If your facility requires a specific product, that's no problem — just let us know during the walkthrough.

satisfaction.q: What if I'm not happy with the cleaning?
satisfaction.a: Then we make it right. If anything's off, call us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re-clean it, free. That's the deal, no arguing about it.

homes.a: Yes — home cleaning, deep cleans and interior painting are available alongside our commercial work, with the same crew and the same written checklist. Request a free estimate and we'll set up a walkthrough.

bilingual.q: Do you offer service in Spanish?
bilingual.a: Claro que sí. Limpios is fully bilingual, so we're glad to help you in English or Spanish, whether that's by phone, by message, or on site.

booking.q: How do I book or get an estimate?
booking.a: Fill out the online estimate request in about two minutes, or just call us. Either way we'll schedule a free walkthrough and lock in a time that works for you.
